`01 · PICK` 

Choose a style that matches your brand's personality and audience, not just what's trending.   
**`02 · FILL IN`** 

Replace every \[BRACKET\] in the prompt with your product, page and content.   
**`03 · PASTE`** 

Use it in Claude, v0, Lovable, Bolt, Cursor or Figma AI. Attach the example image as a visual reference.   
**`04 · ITERATE`** 

Ask for tweaks: "more   
whitespace", "make it mobile first", "add a pricing section in the same style".

**`01` Minimalism** 

*Say more with less.* 

`example · minimalism.design` 

`![][image9]`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Minimalism strips an interface down to what matters: one idea per screen, generous whitespace, a restrained palette and quiet typography. Every element must earn its place, so hierarchy comes from spacing and scale rather than decoration. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Huge whitespace, few elements per view 

→ One accent colour (or none) 

→ Thin type, small caps nav, quiet borders 

→ A single hero object or line of copy 

→ Motion is slow and subtle   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#FAFAF8 #111111 #8A8A85 #E6E4DF #C9A27E T Y P E F A C E S`   
Inter, Helvetica Now, Neue Montreal 

**`B E S T F O R`** 

Premium products, portfolios, studios, single-product launches 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design a landing page for [PRODUCT] in a strict Minimalist style. Off-white background (#FAFAF8), near-black text (#111). One centered hero: a single product image on a soft shadow, a 2-line headline in a light 56px sans-serif with tight tracking, one quiet text link as the CTA. Navigation: 3 small links, 12px, letter spaced. At least 120px vertical padding between sections, max 3 elements per section, no cards, no gradients, no icons. Use one warm accent (#C9A27E) only for hover states. Hierarchy comes from size and spacing only.` 

`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE · MINIMALISM 03`  
`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE CLEAN & STRUCTURED 02 / 28` 

**`02` Swiss Design** 

*The grid is the hero.* 

`example · swiss-design.design` 

`![][image10]`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Also called the International Typographic Style (1950s Switzerland). It is built on a rigid modular grid, flush-left sans-serif type, asymmetric layouts and objective clarity. Big numbers, bold rules and red/black/white palettes make information feel engineered. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Visible modular grid and strong alignment 

→ Flush-left, ragged-right Helvetica-style type 

→ Asymmetric composition, huge type scale jumps 

→ Red, black and white with geometric shapes 

→ Numbers and labels used as graphic elements   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#FFFFFF #111111 #E30613 #F2F2F2 #9B9B9B T Y P E F A C E S`   
Helvetica Neue, Inter, Neue Haas Grotesk **`B E S T F O R`**   
Agencies, conferences, architecture, data-heavy sites 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design a homepage for [EVENT / STUDIO] in classic Swiss (International Typographic) style. Build on a visible 12-column grid with thin hairline rules. Use one grotesk typeface (Helvetica Neue or Inter) only, flush-left and ragged-right, with dramatic size contrast: a 140px bold headline next to 11px captions. Palette: white, black and signal red (#E30613) only. Add one large geometric shape (a red circle) placed asymmetrically. Use numbered sections (01, 02, 03) as graphic elements. No shadows, no rounded corners, no images except optional black-and-white photography.` 

`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE · SWISS DESIGN 04`  
`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE CLEAN & STRUCTURED 03 / 28` 

**`03` Bento Grid** 

*Everything in its box.* 

`example · bento-grid.design` 

`![][image11]`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Named after the Japanese lunch box, Bento layouts arrange features into a tidy grid of rounded tiles of different sizes. Each tile tells one small story (a stat, a feature, a visual), so a whole product can be scanned at a glance. Popularised by Apple keynotes and modern SaaS sites. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Rounded tiles of mixed sizes on one grid 

→ One idea per tile: stat, icon, screenshot 

→ Consistent gaps (12-20px) and corner radius 

→ Often dark mode with one accent per tile 

→ Great for feature overviews and dashboards   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#0B0B0F #17171D #7C5CFF #3DDC97 #F5F5F7 T Y P E F A C E S`   
SF Pro, Inter, Geist 

**`B E S T F O R`** 

SaaS feature sections, product launches, portfolios, dashboards 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** 

`Create a features section for [PRODUCT] using a Bento Grid layout. Dark background (#0B0B0F), tiles in #17171D with 24px radius, 16px gaps, on a 4-column grid with mixed spans (one 2x2 hero tile, two 2x1 tiles, three 1x1 tiles). Each tile holds exactly one idea: a big stat, a feature with an icon, a mini chart, or a UI screenshot. Use Inter/Geist, white headings, grey (#9A9AA5) body. Give each tile a subtle accent glow (violet #7C5CFF or mint #3DDC97). Hover: tile lifts 4px and the border brightens. Make it responsive: tiles stack to 1 column on mobile.` 

`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE · BENTO GRID 05`  
`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE CLEAN & STRUCTURED 04 / 28` 

**`04` Editorial Design** 

*Read it like a magazine.* 

`example · editorial-design.design` 

`![][image12]`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Editorial design borrows from print magazines and newspapers: expressive serif headlines, multi-column text, drop caps, pull quotes, captions and rules. It treats the web page as a crafted spread, prioritising reading rhythm and storytelling over app-like components. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Large contrasting serif headlines 

→ Multi-column body, drop caps, pull quotes 

→ Thin rules, issue numbers, bylines, captions 

→ Full-bleed photography with art direction 

→ Mix of serif display \+ clean sans for meta   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#F4EFE6 #1A1A1A #B23A2B #D9D0C1 #6B6358 T Y P E F A C E S`   
Playfair Display, GT Super, Canela \+ Inter **`B E S T F O R`**   
Blogs, publications, long-form stories, brand journals 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** 

`Design a long-form article page for [PUBLICATION] in a print-magazine Editorial style. Warm paper background (#F4EFE6), ink text (#1A1A1A), one red accent (#B23A2B). Masthead with issue number and date separated by thin rules. Headline in a high-contrast serif (Playfair Display, 80px, tight leading) with an italic deck below. Body text in 3 columns with a large drop cap, a pull quote breaking across columns, and a full-bleed photo with a small caption. Bylines and section labels in a small letter-spaced sans-serif. No cards, no rounded corners, no shadows.` 

`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE · EDITORIAL DESIGN 06`  
`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE CLEAN & STRUCTURED 05 / 28` 

**`05` Luxury Typography** 

*Type that whispers money.* 

`example · luxury-typography.design` 

`![][image13]`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Luxury typographic design lets elegant letterforms carry the brand. Think oversized high-contrast serifs, refined italics, wide letter spaced capitals and a near-monochrome palette with a touch of gold. Restraint, slow pacing and impeccable spacing signal exclusivity. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Oversized, high-contrast serif display type 

→ Wide-tracked uppercase labels 

→ Black / ivory palette with metallic accent 

→ Lots of negative space, centered symmetry 

→ Slow fades and refined micro-interactions   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#0E0D0B #F3EDE2 #C6A15B #2A2723 #8C8475 T Y P E F A C E S`   
Cormorant Garamond, Didot, Bodoni Moda \+ a fine sans 

**`B E S T F O R`** 

Fashion, jewellery, hotels, perfume, fine dining 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** 

`Design a homepage for [LUXURY BRAND] using Luxury Typography as the main visual. Deep black background (#0E0D0B), ivory text (#F3EDE2) and a muted gold accent (#C6A15B) for thin 1px rules and small details. Hero: the brand name in an oversized high-contrast serif (Cormorant Garamond / Didot, 160px+), with one word in italic. Navigation and labels in tiny uppercase with 0.4em letter-spacing. Centered, symmetric composition with huge margins. A single thin-outline CTA button. Very slow fade-in animations. No icons, no bright colours, no rounded shapes.`

**`06` Bauhaus`NEW`** 

*Circle, square, triangle.* 

`example · bauhaus.design` 

`![][image14]`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Rooted in the 1919 German art school, Bauhaus design reduces everything to primary colours and primary shapes. Bold geometric blocks, sans-serif type and functional composition create posters turned-interfaces that feel playful yet disciplined. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Primary colours: red, yellow, blue \+ black 

→ Circles, squares, triangles as layout blocks 

→ Geometric sans-serif, often rotated type 

→ Flat colour, no gradients or shadows 

→ Function-first, asymmetric balance   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#F2EBDD #D7263D #F4B400 #1E4CA1 #111111 T Y P E F A C E S`   
Futura, Josefin Sans, Archivo Black 

**`B E S T F O R`** 

Creative studios, museums, education, posters & events 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design a hero section for [STUDIO / EVENT] in a Bauhaus style. Cream background (#F2EBDD). Compose the layout from large flat geometric shapes: a red (#D7263D) circle, a yellow (#F4B400) quarter-circle, a blue (#1E4CA1) square and a black triangle, overlapping on a hidden grid. Typography: a heavy geometric sans-serif (Futura / Archivo Black) in uppercase, with one word rotated 90°. Use thick black bars as dividers. No gradients, no` 

`shadows, no rounded cards. Buttons are flat rectangles in primary colours. Hover states swap colours between shapes.`

**`07` Neumorphism** 

*Soft plastic, pressed into the page.* 

`example · neumorphism.design` 

`![][image15]`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Neumorphism (new skeuomorphism) makes elements look extruded from, or pressed into, the background itself. The element shares the background colour and is shaped only by a light shadow on one side 

and a dark shadow on the other. It feels calm and tactile, but needs care for contrast and accessibility. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Element colour \= background colour 

→ Dual shadows: light top-left, dark bottom-right 

→ Inset shadows for pressed/active states 

→ Soft rounded controls: dials, toggles, sliders 

→ Low contrast; add one accent for accessibility   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#E0E5EC #A3B1C6 #FFFFFF #4D5B7C #6C63FF T Y P E F A C E S`   
Nunito, Poppins, Manrope 

**`B E S T F O R`** 

Smart-home controls, music players, calculators, widgets 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** 

`Design a smart-home control app screen in Neumorphism style. Background and all elements use the same soft grey (#E0E5EC). Shape everything with dual shadows: -8px -8px 16px #FFFFFF and 8px 8px 16px #A3B1C6. Include: a large circular thermostat dial with an inset track, 4 room toggle cards, a pressed (inset-shadow) active state, a pill slider for lights. Rounded corners 24-32px. Text in dark slate (#4D5B7C), one accent (#6C63FF) for active values to keep contrast accessible. Font: Nunito or Manrope. No borders, no gradients except subtle ones on knobs.` 

`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE · NEUMORPHISM 09`  
`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE SOFT & TACTILE 08 / 28` 

**`08` Glassmorphism** 

*Frosted glass over colour.* 

`example · glassmorphism.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Glassmorphism layers translucent, frosted panels over vivid, blurred backgrounds. Background blur, a thin bright border and subtle transparency create depth and a sense of hierarchy, as if the interface were made of sheets of frosted glass floating above colour. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Background blur (backdrop-filter) on panels 

→ Semi-transparent white fills (10-25%) 

→ 1px light border to catch the 'edge' 

→ Vivid gradient blobs behind the glass 

→ Layered depth with soft shadows   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#1B1640 #FF5ACD #5B8CFF #FFFFFF #FFFFFF T Y P E F A C E S`   
SF Pro, Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans 

**`B E S T F O R`** 

Fintech cards, music & weather apps, dashboards, OS-style UIs 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design a finance dashboard for [APP] in Glassmorphism style. Background: deep indigo (#1B1640) with 3 large blurred gradient blobs (pink #FF5ACD, blue #5B8CFF, orange). Panels are frosted glass: background rgba(255,255,255,0.12), backdrop-filter: blur(20px), 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.3), 24px radius, soft shadow. Include a glass credit card, a balance card with a line chart, and a recent transactions list. White text with 70% opacity for secondary text. Font: Inter / Plus Jakarta Sans. Make sure text contrast stays readable over the blur.` 

`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE · GLASSMORPHISM 10`  
`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE SOFT & TACTILE 09 / 28` 

**`09` Claymorphism** 

*Puffy, squishy, friendly 3D.* 

`example · claymorphism.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Claymorphism makes UI elements look like soft inflated clay: big rounded shapes, pastel colours, and a combination of outer drop shadows with inner highlights and inner shadows. It feels playful and approachable, often paired with 3D clay illustrations. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Very round corners (30px+) and pill buttons 

→ Outer shadow \+ inner light \+ inner dark shadow 

→ Pastel, candy-like colours 

→ 3D clay-style illustrations and blobs 

→ Chunky rounded fonts   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#EFE7FF #FF8FB1 #7CC6FE #FFD36E #3B2A63 T Y P E F A C E S`   
Fredoka, Baloo 2, Nunito 

**`B E S T F O R`** 

Kids & education, habit trackers, playful fintech, onboarding 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design a mobile habit-tracker landing page in Claymorphism style. Pastel lavender background (#EFE7FF). All cards and buttons look like puffy clay: border-radius 32px+, an outer drop shadow (12px 12px 24px rgba(120,80,180,.3)) PLUS inner highlights (inset 6px 6px 12px rgba(255,255,255,.7)) and inner shade (inset -6px -6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.12)). Candy colours: pink #FF8FB1, sky #7CC6FE, butter #FFD36E. Add 3D clay-style blobs and a smiling mascot. Rounded chunky font (Fredoka / Baloo 2), deep purple text (#3B2A63). Buttons squish (scale 0.95) on press.` 

`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE · CLAYMORPHISM 11`

**`10` Skeuomorphism `NEW`** 

*Make it look real.* 

`example · skeuomorphism.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Skeuomorphism imitates real-world materials and objects: leather, brushed metal, wood, paper, glossy buttons and realistic lighting. It was the signature of early iPhone apps and is making a comeback as 'tactile' design, giving users instantly familiar, satisfying controls. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Realistic textures: metal, leather, wood, paper 

→ Detailed lighting, gradients and highlights 

→ Physical metaphors: knobs, switches, notebooks 

→ Embossed/debossed text and stitching 

→ Rich depth and drop shadows   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#2B2B2E #C9CCD1 #6E4B2A #F2D16B #E04A3A T Y P E F A C E S`   
SF Pro, Helvetica Neue, Lucida Grande 

**`B E S T F O R`** 

Audio/music tools, camera apps, retro-tech products, games 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design a vintage synthesizer/audio plugin interface for [APP] in full Skeuomorphism. A brushed aluminium faceplate (layered linear gradients with fine noise) set inside walnut wood side panels. Include realistic rotary knobs with metallic radial highlights and tick marks, a glowing amber VU meter with a needle, chunky toggle switches, and embossed engraved labels (text-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5)). Use realistic top down lighting, screws in the corners, and soft drop shadows so every control looks touchable. Font: Helvetica Neue, small caps labels.`

**`11` Ethereal** 

*Light, mist and quiet glow.* 

`example · ethereal.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Ethereal design feels weightless and dreamlike: soft pastel gradients that fade into mist, glowing orbs, grain, delicate thin serifs and lots of air. It evokes calm, spirituality and wellness, using light itself as the main visual element. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Soft pastel gradients that dissolve to white 

→ Glowing orbs, halos and light leaks 

→ Thin, airy serif or light sans type 

→ Film grain / noise for softness 

→ Slow floating motion   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#F7F3FF #D9C8FF #FFD9E8 #CDEBFF #5E5873 T Y P E F A C E S`   
Cormorant, Fraunces Light, Inter Light 

**`B E S T F O R`** 

Wellness, meditation, skincare, spiritual & beauty brands 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design a landing page for [WELLNESS / MEDITATION APP] in an Ethereal style. Background: a soft misty gradient of lavender (#D9C8FF), blush (#FFD9E8) and sky (#CDEBFF) dissolving into near-white (#F7F3FF), with a large glowing white orb and gentle light-leak halos. Add subtle film grain. Headline in a thin, airy serif (Cormorant / Fraunces Light, 72px) in muted plum (#5E5873); body in Inter Light. Translucent pill buttons with soft glow. Elements slowly float (6-10s ease-in-out loops). No hard edges, no strong contrast, plenty of breathing room.`

**`12` Aurora Gradient`NEW`** 

*Living colour mesh.* 

`example · aurora-gradient.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Aurora (or mesh-gradient) design uses large, blurred, flowing gradients that resemble the northern lights, usually on dark backgrounds. The gradient is the brand: it moves slowly, glows behind content and gives modern AI and tech products an energetic, premium feel. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Large blurred mesh gradients, often animated 

→ Dark base so colours glow 

→ Clean sans type and minimal UI on top 

→ Subtle grain to avoid banding 

→ Glowing borders and light beams   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#07070C #6A5BFF #00D1B2 #FF4FD8 #F2F2F7 T Y P E F A C E S`   
Geist, Inter, Satoshi 

**`B E S T F O R`** 

AI products, SaaS launches, crypto, developer tools 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** 

`Design a hero section for [AI PRODUCT] in an Aurora Gradient style. Near-black background (#07070C) with a large, softly blurred aurora mesh gradient (violet #6A5BFF, teal #00D1B2, magenta #FF4FD8) flowing behind the headline and slowly animating (20s loop). Add fine noise to prevent banding. Headline in Geist/Inter semibold 72px, white, tight tracking, with a small pill announcement badge above it. A glowing primary button with a gradient border, and a product screenshot below with a light-beam glow on its top edge. Keep UI minimal so the light is the hero.`

**`13` Neo-Brutalism** 

*Loud, raw, unapologetic.* 

`example · neo-brutalism.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Neo-Brutalism takes the raw honesty of brutalist web design and adds colour. Thick black outlines, hard offset shadows with zero blur, clashing flat colours and chunky type make interfaces look deliberately unpolished, confident and fun. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Thick black borders (2-4px) on everything 

→ Hard offset shadows: 6px 6px 0 \#000 

→ Flat, saturated, clashing colours 

→ Chunky grotesk type, stickers, tilted badges 

→ Visible structure, no gradients, no blur   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#FFE94A #FF6B9E #4D7CFE #00C48C #111111 T Y P E F A C E S`   
Archivo Black, Space Grotesk, Lexend Mega **`B E S T F O R`**   
Startups, indie tools, creator brands, Gen-Z products 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design a landing page for [STARTUP] in Neo-Brutalism style. Bright yellow background (#FFE94A). Every card, button and image gets a 3px solid black border and a hard offset shadow (6px 6px 0 #000, no blur). Use flat clashing colours: pink #FF6B9E, blue #4D7CFE, green #00C48C. Typography: Archivo Black for huge headlines, Space Grotesk for body. Add tilted sticker badges, a marquee ticker strip, and chunky buttons that move 3px down-right and lose their shadow on press. Squared or lightly rounded (8px) corners. No gradients, no blur, no subtle greys.`

**`14` Maximalism** 

*More is more.* 

`example · maximalism.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Maximalism rejects restraint. It layers bold patterns, clashing colours, multiple typefaces, stickers, collage and texture into rich, dense compositions. Done well, it feels curated chaos: joyful, energetic and impossible to ignore. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Layered patterns: stripes, dots, checks 

→ Many colours and several typefaces at once 

→ Collage, stickers, overlapping elements 

→ Oversized, rotated and outlined type 

→ Dense composition with a clear focal point   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#FF3D7F #FFD400 #2B59FF #00B37E #FF7A00 T Y P E F A C E S`   
Abril Fatface \+ Monoton \+ Space Grotesk (mix\!) **`B E S T F O R`**   
Fashion drops, festivals, music, creative agencies, youth brands 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design a homepage for [FESTIVAL / FASHION DROP] in a Maximalist style. Layer multiple bold patterns (checkerboard, polka dots, stripes) in clashing colours: hot pink #FF3D7F, yellow #FFD400, cobalt #2B59FF, green #00B37E, orange #FF7A00. Mix 3 typefaces (a fat serif like Abril Fatface, a display font like Monoton, a grotesk for body). Overlap rotated photo cut-outs, stickers, starbursts and a scrolling marquee. Keep one huge headline as the focal point so it reads despite the chaos. Add playful hover wiggles. Embrace density, but keep the CTA obvious.` 

`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE · MAXIMALISM 16`

→ Bright pastels \+ black outlines 

→ Terrazzo and grid patterns 

→ Playful, slightly off-kilter layouts 

→ Rounded geometric type

**`18` Pixel Art** 

*8-bit charm, modern layout.* 

`example · pixel-art.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Pixel Art design brings back the blocky graphics of 8- and 16-bit games: bitmap fonts, chunky pixel icons, stepped edges and limited palettes. On modern clean layouts (like the reference post) it feels nostalgic, playful and handcrafted while staying readable. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Bitmap / pixel fonts for headlines and nav 

→ Icons and illustrations built on a visible pixel grid 

→ Stepped (non-anti-aliased) shapes, hard edges 

→ Limited palette, often on a clean light background 

→ Retro game UI: health bars, score counters   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#F1F1F4 #2A1FE0 #111111 #FF4FB8 #E23B3B T Y P E F A C E S`   
Press Start 2P, VT323, Silkscreen, PP NeueBit **`B E S T F O R`**   
Gaming, creative agencies, indie products, playful portfolios 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design an agency homepage for [STUDIO] in a Pixel Art style on a modern, clean layout. Light grey background (#F1F1F4). A giant headline in a blocky pixel font (Press Start 2P / PP NeueBit) in electric blue (#2A1FE0), with a black pixel subheading underneath. Navigation and labels in a monospaced bitmap font (VT323). Decorate with pixel-art icons drawn on a visible grid: a red 3D-ish pixel heart, pixel clouds, sparkles. Hot-pink (#FF4FB8) pixel button with a hard 1-step shadow. Stats row with big pixel numbers (20+, 85+, 42+). Use image-rendering: pixelated; no anti-aliased curves.` 

`UI STYLE FIELD GUIDE · PIXEL ART 20`

Y2K design channels the late-90s/early-2000s vision of the future: liquid chrome type, iridescent holographic gradients, glossy bubble buttons, sparkles, blobby shapes and translucent tech. It is shiny, optimistic and nostalgic for Gen-Z audiences.

→ Glossy pill buttons with highlights 

→ Sparkles ✦, stars, butterflies, blobby 3D shapes 

→ Translucent windows and early-web UI nods

Background: soft holographic iridescent gradient (pink #FF9DE2, baby blue #8FD3FF, lilac #C9B6FF). Headline in liquid chrome lettering (silver gradient fill, white highlights, dark outline, slight bevel). Glossy pill buttons with a white top highlight and inner glow. Decorate with 4-point sparkles` ✦`, chrome blob shapes, a butterfly and a translucent early 2000s window panel with a title bar. Fonts: a wide futuristic display face (Michroma / Syne) plus a clean sans. Add gentle shimmer animations.`

**`20` Vaporwave`NEW`** 

*Statues, sunsets and old Windows.* 

`example · vaporwave.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Vaporwave is an ironic, dreamy internet aesthetic built from 80s-90s consumer tech: Greek statues, pastel pink and teal, checkerboard floors, palm trees, Windows 95 windows, Japanese text and glitchy VHS effects. It feels nostalgic, surreal and slightly melancholic. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Pink \+ teal \+ purple pastel gradients 

→ Retro OS windows, cursors, low-res graphics 

→ Classical statues, palms, checkerboard floors 

→ Wide-spaced text ('Ａ Ｅ Ｓ Ｔ Ｈ Ｅ Ｔ Ｉ Ｃ') & Japanese → VHS noise, scanlines, glitch   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#FF71CE #01CDFE #05FFA1 #B967FF #FFFB96 T Y P E F A C E S`   
VT323, MS Sans Serif-style, wide-spaced serif **`B E S T F O R`**   
Music & playlists, art projects, streetwear, meme savvy brands 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design a music/playlist page for [ARTIST] in a Vaporwave aesthetic. Pastel sunset gradient sky (pink #FF71CE to purple #B967FF), a perspective checkerboard floor, palm-tree silhouettes and a classical marble bust. Overlay a Windows-95-style window (grey bevelled title bar in #01CDFE) containing the track list and a retro media player. Headline in full-width spaced letters ('`Ｖ Ａ Ｐ Ｏ Ｒ`') with Japanese katakana underneath. Use VT323 for UI text, add VHS scanlines, slight chromatic aberration and a pixel cursor.`

**`22` Cybercore** 

*The early internet, overclocked.* 

`example · cybercore.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Cybercore is a nostalgic, hacker-flavoured internet aesthetic: terminal windows, ASCII art, glitchy RGB-split text, wireframe globes, binary rain, pop-ups and acid-green on black. It celebrates raw digital culture and the feeling of being 'jacked in' to the web. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Terminal / command-line windows and monospace → Acid green, cyan and magenta on black 

→ Glitch, RGB split, scanlines, noise 

→ ASCII art, wireframes, binary/hex data 

→ OS pop-ups, loading bars, cursor blinks   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#050505 #39FF14 #00F0FF #FF00E5 #C0C0C0 T Y P E F A C E S`   
JetBrains Mono, VT323, Orbitron 

**`B E S T F O R`** 

Developer tools, hackathons, security, music & digital art 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design a hackathon landing page for [EVENT] in Cybercore style. Pure black background (#050505) with faint scanlines and a dim green grid. Main content inside terminal windows with title bars ('root@cyber:~$'), monospaced text (JetBrains Mono / VT323) in acid green #39FF14, blinking cursor. Headline uses RGB-split glitch (text-shadow 3px 0 #FF00E5, -3px 0 #00F0FF). Add an ASCII-art logo, a rotating wireframe globe, a fake loading bar, binary rain columns and a warning pop-up. Hover = glitch jitter animation.`

**`23` Cyberpunk** 

*High tech, low life, neon rain.* 

`example · cyberpunk.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Cyberpunk design depicts a dystopian neon future: dark rainy cityscapes, aggressive yellow/magenta/cyan neon, angular clipped corner panels, HUD overlays, Japanese signage and glitch. It feels edgy, futuristic and immersive, like the UI of a sci-fi game. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Dark city backdrops with neon glow 

→ Angular panels with clipped corners (clip-path) 

→ HUD details: brackets, coordinates, scanners 

→ Acid yellow \+ hot magenta \+ cyan accents 

→ Katakana / kanji, glitch and warning stripes   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#0A0A12 #FCEE0A #FF003C #00F0FF #1E1E2E T Y P E F A C E S`   
Orbitron, Rajdhani, Chakra Petch

Games, esports, tech launches, streetwear, sci-fi content

Dark rainy neon city backdrop (#0A0A12) with silhouetted skyscrapers and glowing signs in katakana. UI panels have sharp clipped corners (clip-path polygons), thin cyan (#00F0FF) borders and HUD brackets, coordinates and small data readouts. Primary accent is acid yellow (#FCEE0A) with hot red-magenta (#FF003C) for warnings. Headline in Orbitron / Chakra Petch, uppercase, with a slight glitch offset. Angular yellow CTA button with a notched corner, yellow-black warning stripes, rain streaks and flicker animations.`

**`24` Surrealism** 

*Dream logic as interface.* 

`example · surrealism.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Surrealist design borrows from Magritte and Dalí: impossible scenes, floating objects, doors in the sky, giant eyes, melting forms and dramatic shadows. It makes a brand feel imaginative and memorable by bending reality while keeping the UI itself simple. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Impossible compositions: floating, oversized objects → Arches, doors, stairs leading nowhere 

→ Dreamy skies and long cast shadows 

→ Clean serif/sans type placed calmly on top 

→ Unexpected scale and scroll-driven reveals   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#9EC9F0 #F4D9B8 #E86A4A #2D3A6B #FFF8EC T Y P E F A C E S`   
DM Serif Display, Syne, Fraunces 

**`B E S T F O R`** 

Art & culture, creative agencies, fragrances, music, storytelling 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** `Design a homepage for [CREATIVE BRAND] in a Surrealist style inspired by Magritte. A calm sky-blue gradient (#9EC9F0) above a sandy plane (#F4D9B8) with a perspective checkerboard floor fading into the distance. Place impossible objects: a free-standing doorway opening onto a night sky, a giant floating sphere with a long cast shadow, a staircase that ends in the air, and a cloud passing through an arch. Headline in an elegant serif (DM Serif Display, 64px) in deep navy (#2D3A6B). Keep UI minimal; objects drift slowly on scroll (parallax).`

**`25` Art Deco `NEW`** 

*Gatsby-era glamour.*

`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Art Deco (1920s-30s) is symmetrical, geometric and glamorous: gold line work, sunbursts, fan shapes, stepped forms and tall condensed type on deep black, emerald or navy. It signals luxury, celebration and timeless craftsmanship. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Strict symmetry and stepped geometry 

→ Gold line ornaments, sunbursts, fans, chevrons 

→ Tall, condensed, high-waisted display type 

→ Deep jewel tones (black, emerald, navy) \+ gold 

→ Framed panels with double gold borders

`#0B1A17 #D4AF37 #0F4C3A #F3E9D2 #1C1C1C T Y P E F A C E S`   
Poiret One, Limelight, Josefin Sans

Hotels & bars, weddings, events & galas, premium spirits

Deep emerald-black background (#0B1A17) with gold (#D4AF37) geometric line ornaments: a central sunburst fan, stepped ziggurat corners, chevrons and double-line frames. Strict symmetry. Headline in a tall, condensed geometric display font (Poiret One / Limelight) with wide letter-spacing; ivory body text (#F3E9D2). Gold outline buttons with stepped corners. **`28` Wabi-Sabi** 

*Beauty in imperfection.* 

`example · wabi-sabi.design` 

`![]()`  
`W H A T I T M E A N S` 

Wabi-Sabi is a Japanese philosophy that finds beauty in the imperfect, impermanent and incomplete. In UI it means earthy neutrals, natural textures (paper, clay, stone), asymmetric layouts, irregular organic shapes, generous emptiness and a calm, contemplative pace. 

**`S I G N A T U R E M O V E S`** 

→ Muted earthy neutrals, paper and clay textures 

→ Asymmetry and irregular organic shapes 

→ Lots of empty space (ma) 

→ Quiet serif or mincho type, vertical text 

→ Slow, gentle transitions; nothing flashy   
**`P A L E T T E`** 

`#EEE9E0 #C8BFB0 #8B7E6A #4A4238 #A65E3A T Y P E F A C E S`   
Shippori Mincho, Cormorant, Noto Serif JP **`B E S T F O R`**   
Ceramics, tea houses, architecture, skincare, mindful products 

▸ **`P R O M P T · B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ]`** 

`Design a homepage for [CERAMICS / TEA / MINDFUL BRAND] in a Wabi-Sabi style. Warm rice-paper background (#EEE9E0) with subtle paper fibre texture. Asymmetric layout with lots of empty space. A single photo of a hand-made, imperfect ceramic bowl inside an irregular organic shape (uneven border-radius). Earthy neutrals (#C8BFB0, #8B7E6A, #4A4238) and one muted rust accent (#A65E3A) like a hanko seal stamp. Typography: a quiet serif / mincho (Shippori Mincho), small sizes, a short vertical Japanese line. Thin hand-drawn brush stroke divider. Slow fade transitions only.`
